correctness.rationale: The strong triangle inequality makes each radius-δ_j relation an equivalence relation. Inductively c_r(x) determines the isometry type of the radius-δ_r equivalence class of x: accumulate old colours within its E_r ball, decode smaller E_{r-1} blocks, divide each point-multiplicity by block size, and join all blocks at distance δ_r. At r=h-1 the global histogram gives the multiset of top proper balls; join them at δ_h. For h=1 n is encoded by c_0 multiplicity. The one-round signature at h=3 recovers (p,q,n); a unique collision before n=8 is impossible because there cannot be two δ2 balls of size at least 4. At n=8 two size-four partitions have sole nontrivial aggregate ambiguity 2×(2,1,1)↔(2,2)+(1,1,1,1). Separate independent partition-census with raw comparable signatures recovered 1,3,6,14,27,58,111,223 types for n=1..8 and exactly that single pair; this corroborates but does not prove the all-size theorem.
